title: An Act requiring photo ID’s to vote (H.658, filed 2023; accompanied a study order (H4733) 2024-07-15)
operative_text: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives in General Court assembled, and by the authority of the same, as follows: Section 76B, Chapter 54 of the General Laws is hereby amended by adding the following subsection:- (c) -- Any person who seeks to vote in a public election is required to establish his or her qualifications to vote by providing a current valid photo form of identification to election officials prior to voting. Acceptable forms of photo identification provided is either a current driver’s license, a government employee card, a pilot’s license, military identification, a Medicaid or Medicare card, and for students, a photo identification university card.
